extension.description: Lightweight SpringBoot code navigation for VS Code, powered by a Rust/napi-rs native index.
config.title: SpringNav
config.defaultDirection.description: Default direction for Ctrl/Cmd+Click (Go to Definition). down = Controller -> Service -> Impl -> Mapper -> XML, getXX -> field; up = reverse, one level at a time; both = both directions.
config.fallbackOnEmpty.description: When the requested direction has no match, automatically fall back to the opposite direction for one level.
